body: {"hubDatabaseId":7,"sql":"SELECT strftime(\u0027%Y-%m\u0027, O.ORDER_DATE) AS PERIOD, substr(\u0027JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec\u0027, (CAST(strftime(\u0027%m\u0027, O.ORDER_DATE) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 \u002B 1, 3) || \u0027 \u0027 || strftime(\u0027%Y\u0027, O.ORDER_DATE) AS MONTH_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID) AS ORDERS, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_LINES L ON L.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_DATE BETWEEN date(@FROM_DATE) AND date(@TO_DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1","parameters":[{"name":"FROM_DATE","value":"2025-01-01T00:00:00","dbType":6},{"name":"TO_DATE","value":"2025-12-31T00:00:00","dbType":6}]}
